_note: Address book, not a schema store. Keyed by provider@ref. Per entry: defaults (in the model's NATIVE field names, shallow-merged under your input, your input wins), estCostUsd (rough, for dry-run totals), timeoutSec (override of the 15 min default), notes (free text for whoever writes the input; gen inspect gives the live schema). Any endpoint works without an entry here.

replicate@google/nano-banana-2.notes: Usual image default. Reference images go in image_input (array of URLs).

replicate@black-forest-labs/flux-2-max.notes: Reference images go in input_images (array of URLs).

replicate@black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein.notes: Cheapest image model here; good for smoke tests.

replicate@ideogram-ai/ideogram-v3-turbo.notes: Strong at rendering text inside images (posters, signs, UI copy). No output_format field. Only prompt is required. resolution (WxH enum) overrides aspect_ratio when set. magic_prompt_option defaults to Auto and may rewrite prompts; set it to Off when exact on-image wording matters. Style refs go in style_reference_images (array of URLs); style_preset offers named looks. Inpainting via image + mask (black pixels repainted).

replicate@bytedance/seedance-2.5.notes: Seedance 2.5. Image-to-video: the start image goes in image (adaptive keeps its 9:16). About $0.103 per output second at 480p, $0.231 at 720p; duration is whole seconds. reference_images (up to 30) cannot be combined with image.

replicate@bytedance/seedance-2.0-fast.notes: i2v only: needs a start image; fails on pure text-to-video.

replicate@kwaivgi/kling-v3-video.notes: Start image field is start_image. Supports t2v (omit start_image).

replicate@openai/sora-2-pro.notes: Quirks: i2v image field is input_reference; duration field is seconds and only 4, 8 or 12; aspect_ratio is portrait|landscape, not 9:16.

fal@fal-ai/elevenlabs/tts/eleven-v3.notes: TTS via fal. Fields: text, voice (name, e.g. Rachel), stability, similarity_boost, style, speed, apply_text_normalization. For request stitching or word timestamps use the direct elevenlabs provider instead.

fal@fal-ai/elevenlabs/music.notes: Music generation. Fields: prompt, music_length_ms, force_instrumental.

fal@fal-ai/elevenlabs/speech-to-text/scr.notes: STT with word-level timestamps. Fields: audio_url, language_code (e.g. eng), keyterms (max 100 items, 50 chars each).

elevenlabs@speech-to-text.notes: Scribe v3 on ElevenLabs' own API (fal carries v2 only). Fields: file (@path; audio or video up to 5 GB, no splitting needed), num_speakers (max speakers, helps diarization), language_code (auto-detected when omitted), no_verbatim. Returns JSON: text plus words with start, end and speaker_id. Synchronous: pass --timeout generously for long recordings. Cost scales with audio length; estCostUsd is roughly one hour.

fal@fal-ai/bytedance/seedance/v1/pro/fas.notes: Seedance 1 pro fast on fal, image-to-video: the start image goes in image_url, duration is a string (2 to 12). Billed by tokens ($1.0 per million); about $0.039 for 4 s at 480p. Resolution defaults to 1080p upstream, so it is set here.

fal@fal-ai/bytedance/seedance/v1.5/pro/i.notes: Seedance 1.5 pro on fal, image-to-video: the start image goes in image_url, duration is a string (4 to 12). Billed by tokens ($1.2 per million without audio); about $0.047 for 4 s at 480p. Audio defaults on upstream and doubles the price, so it is off here; aspect defaults to 16:9 upstream.

replicate@wan-video/wan-2.2-i2v-fast.notes: Wan 2.2 image-to-video fast: the start image goes in image. No duration field: 81 frames at 16 fps, about 5 s. $0.05 per clip at 480p, $0.065 with interpolation.

fal@xai/grok-imagine-video/v1.5/lite/ima.notes: Grok Imagine 1.5 lite on fal, image-to-video: the start image goes in image_url, duration in whole seconds. $0.02 per second at 480p ($0.03 at 720p) plus $0.01 per input image: $0.09 for 4 s, $0.11 for 5 s. No aspect field (follows the image); the output carries an audio track. The song-ads lane's video default.

fal@blackforestlabs/flux-3/first-last-fr.notes: Flux 3 first-and-last-frame on fal: start_image_url and end_image_url, duration 5 to 20 s, 720p or 1080p. The page says $0.17 per second at 720p ($0.85 for 5 s); fal's pricing API says $0.085 per seconds-unit, half, most likely a 720p second billed as two units.

Flux 3 first-and-last-frame draft on fal (720p): $0.06 per second on the page ($0.30 for 5 s), $0.03 per seconds-unit in the pricing API. Returns a draft cache token beside the clip, for a later full-quality enhancement.
